articles.title: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
articles.snippet: Circle sold 1.24 million shares at $80.84 each and will pay Binance a monthly fee tied to USDC held through its wallet infrastructure.

articles.title: Elon Musk's X brings crypto and stock trading via Coinbase, Kraken and Interactive Brokers partnership
articles.snippet: Elon Musk’s X lets U.S. users tap cashtags such as $BTC to view live charts and access Coinbase, Kraken and other trading platforms.

articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.

articles.title: Binance takes $100M stake in Circle under expanded USDC deal
articles.snippet: Circle sold Binance $100 million in stock and agreed to pay monthly incentives under an expanded five-year partnership promoting USDC.

articles.title: Crypto’s wild boom-and-bust cycles are fading, Solstice CEO says
articles.snippet: Solstice CEO Ben Nadareski says deeper liquidity and growing institutional participation could make future crypto bull runs less volatile than previous cycles.
